integrity: All enumerations are over finite labelled simple edge masks with exact integer arithmetic; independent wheel enumeration and exact rational comparison included.
scientific_limitations: Complete exhaustive statement only for named base size at most six; no claim of persistence for all larger base sizes, of full polynomial real-rootedness, or of independent priority/validation. The normalization uses binomial coefficients indexed by ambient base size.
title: The unique six-point failure of binomial log-concavity for one-types in the four-clique-free homogeneous graph
